title: AES — deployment profile
description: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) is a symmetric block cipher that works on 128-bit blocks with key sizes of 128, 192, or 256 bits. It was designed by Joan Daemen and Vincent Rijmen as Rijndael and adopted by NIST as FIPS-197 in 2001, replacing DES as the United States federal standard.
